name: LA Blind Cube Day 2018

venue.name: [University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)](http://www.ucla.edu/)

information: Spectators must be quiet as the events being held require a lot of concentration on the part of the competitors. Note that FMC Americas 2018 is the next day, and the southern California location is also at UCLA, in the same room. They are separate competitions, and you must register for both if you wish to compete in both. **Please note that no food or drink is allowed in the classroom.**
